    The multiplication table of a multiplicative basis #

    For an algebra Λ with a multiplicative basis b containing a complete set of orthogonal idempotents b (E v), every basis vector lying in one corner, the products of basis vectors define a ray table (multOfBasis): the table of Construction 3.? / Definition 3.9(2) read off from the basis (projective-rays.tex, "b_r b_s = b_{rs} or 0"). Its associativity comes from that of Λ, and its linearization is isomorphic to Λ (linEquiv).
